name: Estival-Hamada
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around active supervolcanoes, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Established during the last boom, the quarantine zone was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
